title: Étale restriction pullback unit equality for fixed base-change étale structure
statement: With the same hypotheses and notation as lem-weil-pbc-etale-restriction-pullback-unit, for a specified Etale p' structure hp', the displayed equality of homomorphisms in that theorem holds.

source.place: agent split of the unit compatibility proof, isolating the equality after étaleness of p' is supplied

proof.text: Apply the unit equation for the uniqueness-of-left-adjoint restriction comparison. Naturality at a morphism psi:c -> pullback(f)(b) identifies the unit followed by restriction and rho_f(c) with F applied to the adjoint transpose of psi. This is the private proved helper restriction_unit; at the two diagonal maps it gives hδ and hσ, including the terminal-object isomorphisms eW and eW'.

Evaluate Etale.upperStarComp_hom_app_unit_app at an étale object b and restrict along psi into the pullback along the composite. Naturality of the composition comparison gives the private proved helper composition_unit. Construct gamma=(g',id) over wx, delta=(id,id) over wx, and sigma=(id,id) over wy'. The two identities hχq and hχj with the pullback-pasting maps follow by extensionality on each projection, using hι₁ and hι₂.

Apply composition_unit to (g',p) and (p',g), with common composite g' ≫ p and equality hcomm for the second pair. Rewrite the pasting identities and use naturality of the units, then hδ and hσ. The resulting equalities hq and hj express the two routes in terms of the same restricted composite unit. Cancel the first composition isomorphism and compare with the second. Precompose by rhoF and F(eW.inv), postcompose by rhoG and gF(eW'.inv), and cancel the four inverse pairs to obtain the stated equality.

split_report.summary: Statement kept (checked: the two sides are maps Gamma(W,p^{-1}F) -> (g^{-1}F)(W'), with eta_{g'}(W) read in K(W') through theta=(g',id)). Wrote a 5-step agent proof following the scheme of lem-weil-pbc-open-restriction-pullback-unit: compute the unit eta_h(W) of h=pg'=gp' through both factorizations with lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition (2), and pass to W' by restricting along the diagonal delta:W->W x_X W (giving (p^{-1}F)(delta) eta_p(W)=rho_F(W)^{-1} from lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-restriction (2)) and along sigma=(iota,id):W'->(W x_X Y) x_Y W'; both routes land at the graph gamma=(g',id):W'->W x_X W', which replaces the monomorphism argument of the open case. No new node needed: everything is carried by existing nodes. The intended adjunction argument of the source field (test after composing with eta_p) is not needed. lean.statement: theorem etale_restriction_pullback_unit_eq {X Y W W' : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (p : W ⟶ X) (g' : W' ⟶ W) (p' : W' ⟶ Y) (hcomm : g' ≫ p = p' ≫ g) (ι : W' ⟶ pullback p g) (hι₁ : ι ≫ pullback.fst p g = g') (hι₂ : ι ≫ pullback.snd p g = p') [IsIso ι] [hp : Etale p] (hp' : Etale p') : let A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} let w : W.Etale := Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 W) let w' : W'.Etale := Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 W') let wx : X.Etale := Scheme.Etale.mk p let wy' : Y.Etale := @Scheme.Etale.mk _ _ p' hp' let eW : (MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ hp).obj w ≅ wx := MorphismProperty.Over.isoMk (Iso.refl W) (by simp [wx, w]) let eW' : (MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ hp').obj w' ≅ wy' := MorphismProperty.Over.isoMk (Iso.refl W') (by simp [wy', w']) let theta : w' ⟶ (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ g').obj w := MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (pullback.lift g' (𝟙 W') (by exact (Category.comp_id g').trans (Category.id_comp g').symm)) (by simp [w']) let iotaSite : wy' ⟶ (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ g).obj wx := MorphismProperty.Over.homMk ι hι₂ ∀ F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A, let pF := (Etale.upperStar A p).obj F let gF := (Etale.upperStar A g).obj F let K := (Etale.upperStar A g').obj pF let rhoF := (Etale.upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction A p hp).hom.app F let rhoG := (Etale.upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction A p' hp').hom.app gF let kappa := (Etale.upperStarComp A g' p).inv.app F ≫ (Etale.upperStarComp A p' g (g' ≫ p) hcomm).hom.app F ((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction A g').unit.app pF).hom.app (op w) ≫ K.obj.map theta.op ≫ kappa.hom.app (op w') ≫ rhoG.hom.app (op w') ≫ gF.obj.map eW'.inv.op = rhoF.hom.app (op w) ≫ F.obj.map eW.inv.op ≫ ((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction A g).unit.app F).hom.app (op wx) ≫ gF.obj.map iotaSite.op
